subject: POC kickoff: NestLogics — scope, success metrics, and next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@nestlogics.com>, Dana Kim <dana.kim@nestlogics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + proposed POC kickoff plan — NestLogics

Alex / Dana — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a suggested POC kickoff plan so we can lock owners and dates. If anything below is off, flag it and we’ll adjust.

Key pain points you called out
- Inconsistent recommendations across user segments (especially onboarding flows) causing conversion drop-offs.
- High latency and token-cost spikes on peak hours for existing reranking pipeline.
- Need deterministic failover and auditability for regulated customers.

Goals for the pilot
- Replace current reranker for onboarding prompts for a subset of traffic (10% initial) and measure impact on conversion and latency.
- Validate cost per 1k tokens and operational behavior under typical traffic.
- Surface structured explainability for top-3 suggestions for compliance reviews.

Proposed POC scope (high level)
- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week integration + 2-week evaluation)
- Traffic: shadow mode for week 1–2, 10% live in week 3–4 if metrics look good
- Success metrics: conversion delta on onboarding cohort, accuracy on labeled eval set (target: >= 85% on key prompts), p95 latency < 350ms, cost target <$6 per 1k tokens (configurable)
- Prompt set & evals: use the prompt set you shared in the call + our synthetics; initial prompt_set_v1.csv attached
- Owners: Rishi (sales/POC lead), Dev Patel (integration/infra), Marissa Cole (CS/monitoring), Jin Park (NestLogics technical lead — pls confirm)

Access/setup required from NestLogics
- Temporary S3 read access to onboarding event logs (sample subset, scrubbed)
- A service account with limited API keys for test environment (scoped to staging)
- Network allowlist entry for our staging IPs (I’ll send CIDR ranges once we align)

Attachments: nl_poc_scope_v1.pdf (detailed tasks), nl_prompt_set_v1.csv (initial prompts and expected labels)

Next steps
1) Confirm Jin Park as technical lead and provide his email for invites.
2) Confirm target kickoff date (we suggested Nov 16 in call).
3) Share minimal access items above by Nov 12 so Dev can start provisioning.

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and an updated scope doc once we get Jin on thread.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC kickoff plan — NestLogics

Rishi — thanks for the thorough recap. High level all looks right. A few notes/questions from our side: 

1) Technical lead: adding Jin Park (jin.park@nestlogics.com) to the thread — he’ll own infra/network with our platform team.
2) Data: we will provide a scrubbed subset of the onboarding events, but we need to confirm the exact fields you need (tokenized text + metadata). Jin — can you confirm?
3) Security/compliance: we need clarity on retention for logs created during the POC and whether audit logs can be exported to our SIEM. We may need a short SOC 2 slip to show the legal team.
4) Timing: Nov 16 works for an internal kickoff on our side — prefer after 12pm PT.

If you can address items 2–3 and send the invite for Nov 16 1pm PT, we’ll route the access requests to Jin.

Appreciate it — looking forward to seeing the scope doc.

Alex Porter
Head of Product 
NestLogics
alex.porter@nestlogics.com

Alex / Jin / team — looping back with a concrete checklist and updated scope doc (nl_poc_scope_v1.1.pdf attached). I also put a short Drive folder together with the prompt set and eval template.

POC kickoff checklist (what we need from NestLogics before Nov 16)
- Provide service account details for staging with the following scopes: S3 read on 'nestlogics-onboarding-samples', API access to staging endpoints (token only), and a support user for retries.
- Confirm list of fields to include in the sample (recommendation: user_id (hashed), timestamp, prompt_text, variant_id, outcome_label).
- Approve retention for POC logs: 30 days from creation, exportable to your SIEM via HTTPS. If you need shorter retention we can scrub earlier — please confirm.

Evaluation plan (concrete)
- Prompt set: 250 labeled prompts + 1k synthetic variations (attached). We’ll run blind evals and return batch metrics.
- Metrics: conversion delta (A/B), labeled accuracy (target >= 85%), p95 latency target < 350ms, failure rate < 0.05%, cost baseline vs current < 10% uplift.
- Reporting cadence: daily automated metrics dashboard, weekly sync with your product team.

Security notes
- We will provide a short SOC2 excerpt and a POC-specific data handling addendum for signature (DocuSign link below).
- All test traffic stays in staging and keys are scoped to the POC account only.

Operational details (for Dev)
- Staging S3 bucket: nestlogics-onboarding-samples (read-only role)
- CIDR allowlist (staging): 34.203.0.0/18, 34.204.0.0/18
- Expected artifact uploads: daily eval batches (CSV), logs (JSONL) to a pre-provisioned folder

Links and attachments
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NestLogicsPOC (prompt_set_v1.csv, eval_template.xlsx)
- DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/landing?docId=NL-POC-2026-3782
- Attached: nl_poc_scope_v1.1.pdf

Can Jin confirm the field list and retention requirements? Once we have that, Dev will send an invite and provision the staging key.

Thanks,
Rishi
